data.one_liner: Manage UI overlays and loading indicators separately from your main navigation.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter package for managing overlays by separating the main UI and navigation from overlay layers. It provides built-in loading indicator support, z-index sorting, and prevents lifecycle issues common with standard dialogs.
use_when: You need to display global loading indicators without interfering with route lifecycles.
You want to manage multiple stacked custom overlays using z-indices.
avoid_when: You are relying strictly on declarative routing paradigms where overlays must be bound directly to route states.
You prefer standard Navigator-based dialog management.
strengths: Separates main UI and navigation from overlays
Built-in loading overlay with easy control
Supports z-index sorting for custom overlays
weaknesses: Relies on imperative singleton or instance calls for showing and hiding overlays
Limited to the provided features without built-in advanced route transition animations
data.setup_notes: Initialize the manager in the MaterialApp builder method.
